_notice: SYNTHETIC — every message below was written by hand for Hookline unit tests. None is a real email, none came from a dataset, and they must never be used to report detection performance.

cases.subject: Your Remote Assistant Position
cases.body: Thank you for applying for the remote assistant job. Before onboarding, you will need to pay a refundable $150 training fee for the starter kit.

cases.subject: Next steps for your position
cases.body: Congratulations on your new remote job. We will send you a check for $2,500. Deposit the check and purchase your laptop from our approved vendor.

cases.subject: Interview for Data Analyst position
cases.body: I am the hiring manager at Contoso and we reviewed your resume for the data analyst position. Please confirm your availability for an interview.

cases.subject: Part-time job opportunity
cases.body: We saw your resume and have a part-time position for you. Please contact our hiring manager on Telegram to continue the process.

cases.subject: Interview scheduled
cases.body: Your interview for the customer service job will be conducted via text chat on Signal app tomorrow at 10am. No phone call is needed.

cases.subject: Job offer
cases.body: Good news! You have been selected for the position of Remote Administrative Assistant. No interview required, you can start on Monday.

cases.subject: Work from home position
cases.body: Hiring now for a part-time job: earn $45/hr, no experience needed, only 2 hours a day from your phone.

cases.subject: Your new position
cases.body: To finish hiring you for the position, please send us your social security number and a photo of your ID by reply.

cases.subject: Flexible online job
cases.body: This remote job is simple. Complete 40 tasks per day rating products. To unlock your commission you must recharge your account with 100 USDT first.

cases.subject: Internship offer
cases.body: We are offering you the summer internship position. Reply within 24 hours to secure your position, as spots are filling fast.

negatives.note: Normal recruiter email from a company domain — must be safe.
negatives.subject: Interview invitation — Software Engineer
negatives.body: Thanks for applying to the Software Engineer position. We'd like to schedule a 45-minute video interview with the hiring team next week. Please pick a time that works for you.

negatives.note: Benefits text with reimbursement, deposit and fees mentioned in benign ways — must be safe.
negatives.subject: Your offer letter and benefits
negatives.body: Attached is your offer letter for the analyst position following your interviews. Benefits include a reimbursement policy for home office equipment and direct deposit of your salary. There are no training fees. The company will pay the application fee for your certification.

negatives.note: Not a job email; mentions a fee and WhatsApp — job rules must not run.
negatives.subject: Book club this Friday
negatives.body: Hi all, the room booking fee is $5 each. Message me on WhatsApp if you can't make it.

negatives.note: 'In case you are selected' is conditional, not an offer.
negatives.subject: Application received
negatives.body: We received your application for the web developer position. In case you are selected for the position, you will be invited to two interview rounds.
